summary: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V filed an 8-K/A to disclose a Forward Purchase Agreement with a fund sub-advised by JBA Asset Management LLC. The agreement is tied to Live Oak's proposed business combination with Teamshares Inc., originally announced in November 2025. Under the terms, Live Oak will pay the seller a prepayment amount from its trust account equal to the number of subject shares (up to 4,000,000) times an initial price determined shortly before closing. This structure is designed to provide backstop capital and reduce redemption risk in the SPAC merger. The forward purchase is structured as an OTC prepaid share forward with optional early termination. Key watch: shareholder approval and redemptions will determine final trust account proceeds.
